pluss::subsp::stats::ts::LagPlan¶

A normalised lag plan: the result of build_lag_plan.

LagPlan is plain data describing the feature columns for each horizon.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

horizon

std::vector<std::int64_t>

—

The horizons.

response_lags

std::vector<std::int64_t>

—

Response lags.

nonleading_predictor_indices, leading_predictor_indices

std::vector<std::int64_t>

—

Predictor columns of each kind.

predictor_lags, leading_unique_lags

vectors of vectors

—

Per-predictor lags; for leading predictors the distinct (possibly negative) offsets in use.

prepared_predictors_per_horizon

pluss::Series

—

A Boolean horizon × feature mask of the features active for each horizon.

max_lag, max_lead

std::int64_t

—

The longest lag and the number of steps the largest horizon looks ahead.

feature_count

std::int64_t

—

The number of feature columns.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
